featured_reviews.name: Manasi Pai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got married in Sanjeevani Banquet hall. I must say it’s one of best banquet halls in the Dahisar-Borivali-Kandivali area.
First things first, the team is so helpful and polite, right from our first visit, we were very happy with the way they treated us. The look and feel of the venue is very lavish. The washrooms particularly are what caught my attention. They are super clean and spacious. You don't need to about your guests. 👍
Unlike most of the banquet halls, Sanjeevani did not force us on vacating the venue at 3pm and agreed to extend our timings by paying the hourly charges. On the day of the wedding as well, everything was managed perfectly! Right from vallet parking, to the decorations, events, sound system, everything was on point. 👏
Special mention to the awesome food ! Everyone loved every single item on the menu, especially the wok station. 😁
A big thank you to the entire team of Sanjeevani Banquets. You made our special day even more special with your friendly and caring attitude !❤️🙏🏻 Special thanks to Mr. Anil Jangid.

I will highly recommend this venue for all your functions 👍

featured_reviews.name: Gandhar Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: Sanjeevani Banquets was the first place of venue we saw and instantly loved and none of the subsequent banquets seemed to match the bar set by Sanjeevani. There are plenty of pretty, elegant decor options to choose from as per your liking. The cherry on the cake definitely has to be the food. Each and every one of our wedding guests highly complimented the venue, the food and overall arrangement. We are glad we chose this as our wedding venue and would definitely highly recommend this to all.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with this wedding and sangeet venue. When we first visited, the staff was very polite and promised to fulfill all our requirements and provide good decor options. However, once we booked the venue and paid the advance, their behavior completely changed.A staff member named Bijal was extremely rude and uncooperative. She does not know how to speak respectfully, even to elders, and was also very rude to my in-laws, which was the most disappointing part for us. The decor options they promised were not good, and we had to spend extra money from our own pocket for decor, even though it was supposed to be included. The only positive part of the experience was the food — it was very good. But overall, the lack of cooperation and rude behavior made the whole experience stressful.

The staff is courteous, attentive, and provides excellent service throughout the event. The management is cooperative and ensures everything is well arranged—from decoration to food quality. featured_reviews.name: Santosh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with my experience at Pooja Banquet AC Hall, Dahisar East (Ashokvan), where I celebrated my daughter's 1st birthday.

I had booked the AC hall from 5:00 PM to 10:30 PM, but when we arrived, the hall operator, Mr. Vilas Desai, was not available to start the AC. He arrived around 6:00 PM, and even then the central AC was not cooling properly. It appeared that he was not familiar with operating the system. After several complaints and discussions with a technician, the AC finally started cooling properly after nearly an hour. During this time, our guests, including children and senior citizens, were uncomfortable due to the heat and humidity.

Another disappointing issue was regarding stage decoration. At the time of booking, a lady named Sakuntala informed us that basic stage decoration was included. However, during the event, we were unexpectedly asked to pay extra for stage curtains and background decoration. This created unnecessary stress during an important family celebration.

We also faced problems related to seating arrangements, additional chairs, counter stand arrangements, and the overall attitude and behavior of some staff members. Customer service and communication were not professional and lacked basic courtesy.

I am sharing this review so that the owner and higher management can take corrective action. No customer should have to face these kinds of issues during a special occasion. A birthday celebration should be a memorable experience, but unfortunately, our experience was disappointing due to poor management and lack of customer service.

I hope the management addresses these concerns seriously to ensure future customers do not face similar problems.

featured_reviews.name: Niyomi Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the delightful ambiance and exceptional service at Gosssip Corner! From the moment I arrived, I was warmly greeted by the staff who guided us to our table. The cafe's atmosphere is inviting, with a perfect blend of modern elegance and cozy charm.

The food is delectable and the menu offers a fantastic variety of both familiar favorites and intriguing new dishes, all beautifully presented and bursting with flavor.

My personal favourite - Enchiladas, Ravioli, Avocado toast and the cold coffee.

Moreover, what truly impressed me was their banquet service. We hosted a friend’s sangeet event there, and the attention to detail from planning to execution was impeccable.

Gosssip Corner is not just a cafe; it's an experience! One that everybody should indulge in! ❤️

10/10 for decor, ambience and a special mention to their food (11/10 for the appetizers) which was served fresh and hot right from their restaurant kitchen!

Highly recommend this place ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
